test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Why are the outermost electrons lost easily down the group?

options.text: The innermost electrons are farther away from the nucleus
The outermost electrons are closest to the nucleus
The outermost electrons are farther away from the nucleus

solution:
The correct answer is __**The**** outermost electrons are farther away from the nucleus.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Tendency of an element to **lose electrons increases** when we go down the** group**.
 
• This is because **atomic size increases** when we go down the **group**.
